versions.subject: PDQDeploy Rules
versions.detection:
selection_root:
    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
selection_service:
    - ImagePath|contains: 'PDQDeployService.exe'
    - ServiceName:
        - 'PDQDeploy'
        - 'PDQ Deploy'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Provider_Name="Service Control Manager" EventID=7045 ImagePath="*PDQDeployService.exe*" OR ServiceName IN ("PDQDeploy", "PDQ Deploy")
